selectionRule: Population: non-merge commits F reachable from REF, excluding the root snapshot, whose subject matches ^fix(\(scope\))?!?: and names at least one ticket or requirement ID (V1-NNNN or PREFIX-VN-NNN). Every diff is -U0 myers with inter-hunk context 0, no textconv, no external diff and no renames, and Git system/global configuration is not read. Touched lines: the old-side lines of F's diff over non-test .go files that are code (not blank, not starting with //, /* or *); a pure insertion of at least one code line touches the old-side lines immediately before and after it; a hunk whose removed and added lines are equal line by line, in order, once every ID is masked (an ID renumbering) touches nothing. Each touched line is blamed at F^ (git blame --porcelain, no -M/-C, no ignored revisions); blame to the root snapshot is dropped. Linked change P: among blamed commits that share at least one ID with F's subject, the one owning the most touched lines (ties: earlier committer date, then SHA). P qualifies when it has between 1 and 60 non-test .go source hunks in its -U0 myers diff against its first parent. One row per P: the earliest qualifying F is the fix, later ones are listed. Rows are ordered by P committer date then SHA; when more than 50 qualify, 40 are taken at index floor(i*n/40). touchedHunks names P's source hunks (changeHunk: 1-based over P's non-test Go hunks in path order) containing a touched line by blame's original line number; touchedLines lists the same lines as [path, line in P] so any hunking (the CEM canonical diff included) can be mapped; laterFixes carry their own touchedHunks and touchedLines. escape is post-merge when P reached the first-parent line of REF in an earlier first-parent commit than F, else same-merge (found by review or integration before P reached main).
